chunks: Then you are the worst of people, and those whom Satan has cast into his targets and struck with his pride!
And two types of people will be ruined with regard to me: an excessive lover whose love takes him away from the truth, and an excessive hater whose hatred takes him away from the truth,
and the best of people in status with regard to me is the moderate one, so hold to him, and hold to the Great Majority, for the hand of Allah is with the community,
and beware of division! For the isolated one from the people is to Satan, just as the isolated one from the sheep is to the wolf.
Behold, whoever calls to this banner, kill him, even if he be under this turban of mine.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Sawad al-A'zam' in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) diagnoses the Kharijites' deviation as a result of excessive zeal, warning that both over-enthusiastic lovers and over-zealous haters of his authority will fall into error. He prescribes the 'moderate middle path' and adherence to the 'Great Majority' (al-Sawad al-A'zam) as the safeguard against sectarianism, famously declaring that the hand of God is with the community. The passage concludes with a decisive command to eliminate those who propagate their specific banner of rebellion, even if it were his own, emphasizing the primacy of communal unity over individual charisma.
